requirements.name: CC3.2 - COSO Principle 7: The entity identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives across the entity and analyzes risks as a basis for determining how the risks should be managed.
requirements.description: POF 7: Identifies Vulnerability of System Components — The entity identifies the vulnerabilities of system components, including system processes, infrastructure, software, and other information assets.

requirements.name: CC3.4 - COSO Principle 9: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.
requirements.description: POF 4: Assess changes from systems, technology environment, and evolving threats/vulnerabilities. Evaluate impact on internal controls and security posture to identify and address resulting risks.

requirements.description: POF 4: Assess changes from systems, technology environment, and evolving threats/vulnerabilities. Evaluate impact on internal controls and security posture to identify and address resulting risks.

requirements.name: CC5.1 - COSO Principle 10: The entity selects and develops control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
requirements.description: POF 6: Addresses Segregation of Duties — Management segregates incompatible duties and, where such segregation is not practical, management selects and develops alternative control activities.

requirements.name: CC6.6 - The entity implements logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.
requirements.description: POF 2: Protects Identification and Authentication Credentials — Identification and authentication credentials are protected during transmission outside its system boundaries.

requirements.name: CC6.8 - The entity implements controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software to meet the entity's objectives.
requirements.description: POF 2: Detects Unauthorized Changes to Software and Configuration Parameters — Processes are in place to detect changes to software and configuration parameters that may be indicative of unauthorized or malicious software.

requirements.name: CC7.1 - To meet its objectives, the entity uses detection and monitoring procedures to identify (1) changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities, and (2) susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.
requirements.description: POF 5: Conducts Vulnerability Scans — The entity conducts infrastructure and software vulnerability scans designed to identify potential vulnerabilities or misconfigurations on a periodic basis and after significant changes are made to the environment. Action is taken to remediate identified deficiencies in a timely manner to support the achievement of the entity's objectives.

requirements.name: CC7.2 - System monitoring for anomalies and security event analysis.
requirements.description: POF 1: Implement detection policies, procedures, and tools on infrastructure and software to identify potential intrusions, unauthorized access, and unusual system activity. Use intelligence sources to identify new threats and vulnerabilities.

requirements.name: CC8.1 - The entity authorizes, designs, develops or acquires, configures, documents, tests, approves, and implements changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.
requirements.description: POF 2: Implement processes to authorize system changes before design or acquisition, test changes prior to production deployment, require formal approval of system changes, and protect confidential information during development and change processes.
